title: %eq - equality test
purpose: Return true when two values are equal, as a boolean usable as a condition.
notes: Both arguments are verb-expressions or paths/literals - never a quoted infix like "@.status == 'active'".
The boolean result drops straight into a condition slot, e.g. %ifElse %eq @.status "active" ... .

avoid.why: an integer source code (##200) compares equal to the string "200": cross-type numeric/string operands are coerced before comparison, so this fires even though one side is text. Quote only when both sides are genuinely strings.
